items.label: SK Telecom press release: Building an 'Asia AI Infrastructure Hub': Interview with (08-13-2026)
items.signal_prefix: SK Hyper, SKT's new company dedicated to AI data center busi

set.signal: SK Hyper, SKT's new company dedicated to AI data center business development, is committed to investing KRW 750 billion through 2030. Its CEO Chung Suk-geun (also Head of SKT's AI CIC): building a 1 GW-scale AI data center requires an investment of potentially tens of trillions of Korean won; "We are already in discussions with global big tech companies on a range of AI data center opportunities"; with data centers becoming increasingly difficult to build and memory for the servers increasingly difficult to secure, the next two to three years will be a critical window, and SK Group's offer to big tech is reliable power, SK hynix memory access combined with SKT's infrastructure operations, and trust.

items.why: Source says data centers are increasingly difficult to BUILD and server memory difficult to SECURE; the entry merged both as 'difficult to secure'
